name: cms-f26
description: Course tooling for Coding for Media Studies (CMS 2026), Columbia University School of the Arts.

plugins.name: cms-starter
plugins.description: Fleet repo tooling: the provenance ledger skill and the weekly checkpoint command.

plugins.name: cms-corpus
plugins.description: Make one artifact from a folder of course readings, any shape, under fixed rules: every claim sourced, every relation between texts stated, every gap declared.

plugins.name: cms-lab
plugins.description: The CMS lab: run /cms-lab:init once to ready your machine, then projects such as the scene-detection workshop in ~/cms-lab.

plugins.name: cms-workflow
plugins.description: Map your research workflow as a page you keep: each step, who does it, who checks it, and how to run it in Cowork.

plugins.name: workflow-interactive
plugins.description: An interactive map of any workflow you draw: swimlanes, sources with real icons, a walkthrough with a debug trace, and pull, commit, and push to your fleet repository.
